EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE GAMPAHA MUNICIPALCOUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Gampaha Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Resigning ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party, the recognized political party to which BasnayakeMudiyanselage Ajithkumara the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon returned member if Sri Lanka Freedom Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualified underSection 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a periodof thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid Recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Rohana Liyanage to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Karunasingha Jayarathnage Sampath Madhawa, Returning Officer of the GampahaMunicipal Council, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) dohereby declare that Rohana Liyanage was selected as the member of the Gampaha Municipal Council .
K. J. S. MADHAWA,Returning Officer,Gampaha Municipal Council.District Election Office,Gampaha,02nd July, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
